description: Turns the Inflearn lectures you own into a searchable knowledge base. Ask about any concept and it pulls the relevant lecture units — semantically searched over subtitles and summaries — and answers from what your instructors actually taught, with links back to the source and the instructor's name. It can also surface your curriculum, enrolled courses, and recent learning history, so everything you've learned stays one question away.

defaultPrompt: Explain Spring DI using my lecture content
Review my code based on what my courses taught
Quiz me on the lecture I watched recently
